purpose: Second policy mining: 3 runs, 16 records, 8 unique task IDs; confirms ENF-RULE-1 (0 FP/3 runs) and ENF-RULE-2 (0 FP/3 runs); no new L2 candidates found
notes: Data gap unchanged from MINING-01: still no score<0.875 records, no edge_unknown, no real nightly CI data. Recommends accumulating ≥30-50 unique records before third mining. All data from smoke fixtures only.

purpose: Third policy mining with first real prod-shadow samples (2 records with infra_risk tag); ENF-RULE-1 maintained as strong L2 candidate but not recommended for blocking canary
